note: The app's backlog as the product team wrote it. Seeds the Jira simulator; a test keeps it equal to the stories the demo app serves.

stories.title: Valid stay dates
stories.criteria:
Check-in is today or later.
Check-out is after check-in; a stay is at least one night.

stories.title: Room capacity
stories.criteria: The number of guests is between 1 and the room's maximum.

stories.title: Correct price
stories.criteria: The total is the number of nights times the nightly rate.

stories.title: Guests can cancel before check-in
stories.criteria:
A guest can cancel their own booking while it is confirmed.
A booking that is checked in or checked out cannot be cancelled.
A cancelled booking shows as Cancelled.

stories.title: Front desk
stories.criteria:
Only signed-in front-desk staff can see all bookings and check guests in or out.
A guest is checked in before being checked out.

stories.title: The quoted rate is the rate charged
stories.criteria: The nightly rate on a booking is the rate shown for that room in the room list.
